mentions.name: Awesome Voice Typing
mentions.description: An awesome-style curated GitHub repository collecting the best open-source speech-to-text / voice typing tools, aimed at people dictating detailed prompts to LLMs and coding agents.
mentions.problem: Finding the available open-source speech-to-text solutions is difficult; the good options are scattered, so the repo consolidates them in one place.
mentions.audience: People dictating detailed prompts to LLMs and coding agents
mentions.source_excerpt: I tried to look for what other solutions are available and I've collected all the best open-source ones in this awesome-style GitHub repo. Hope you find something that works for you!

evidence.value: I tried to look for what other solutions are available and I've collected all the best open-source ones in this awesome-style GitHub repo. Hope you find something that works for you!
